name_zh: Technora 繩練安全檢驗手冊
tags_zh: 安全第一/耗損評估/保養指南
desc_en:
火舞表演安全至關重要！
本篇教你如何以 3 步驟檢視繩練磨耗程度，判斷何時必須更換。
dive1_zh:
Prop safety is non-negotiable.
A concise 3-step guide to assessing wear and knowing when to retire your rope.
dive1_en:
1. 觀察外層纖維起毛情況
2. 檢查連接環受力點是否有壓扁變形
3. 彎折測試是否有內部硬化脆裂感
dive2_zh:
1. Check for surface fuzzing
2. Inspect load points at swivels for deformation
3. Bend test to feel for internal brittleness
dive2_en: 若發現直徑磨損縮小超過 20%，請務必立即停止點火使用並進行更換。
column16: If diameter is reduced by more than 20%, retire immediately.
